size_why: The economy is structurally reworked (comeback souls gutted on three levers, rift resist no longer flat 35%), movement changes with a new air-drag slow clause, and dash/light-melee no longer pause gun cycle time — these change how games are won, not just hero numbers. The 36 item and 69 hero tweaks ride on top of that structural base.
headline: The comeback valve is now fully closed: win lane and snowball with tempo, while the on-hit spirit carry archetype is killed three ways in one patch.

meta_thesis.previous: The 07-30 rework had started rewarding tempo, but comeback bounties and the flat rift resist still bailed out the team that lost lane.
meta_thesis.new: Winning lane now converts directly into the game: comeback souls are gone, early rift fights are real fights, and combat is smoothed toward aggressive high-APM dueling. Late scalers and flyers lose the safety nets that bought them time to spike.
meta_thesis.why: The three-lever comeback gutting plus the scaling rift resist finishes the 07-30 direction, and the air-drag slow plus gun-cycle smoothing push dueling and map tempo further. No reversal — the same trend, now structural.

winners.why: Health/boon 28->31, sprint 1.5->2.5, and Weighted Bola now grounds/interrupts flyers on top of gun-cycle smoothing and the tempo economy — the patch is literally built for her kit.
Heavy Melee spirit scaling 0.3->0.45 and Captivating Read buffs land in a lane-wins economy that already rewards her snowball-a-carry role.
Absent from the notes, but the closed comeback valve and nerfed early rift resist let his invade/escape tempo convert to wins; only his secondary Locket line got trimmed.
Crackshot T2 shred, more HP/boon, longer Lasso, and the 35->38s 20m respawn all raise the value of her picks — caveat is her stripped Veil Walker disengage.
Tempo/lane-wins economy plays directly to her early dive snowball, and her melee-spirit core items are untouched.

losers.why: Direct gun stat, Flask, and Willpower cuts plus both his T4 finishers (Mercurial Magnum, Spiritual Overflow) gutted — the patch's clearest casualty.
Seven direct nerfs stack on Radiant Regeneration/Locket trims and the new air-drag slow that taxes her as a flyer and late scaler.
Her 93%-share Magnum capstone cut and Plated Armor now blanks her spirit-amp/Tesla splice, forcing a full pivot to pure gun.
Card Trick and shred nerfs plus the Magnum cut and Plated Armor blocking Full Auto's spirit damage hollow out her entire on-hit build.
Flyer tax: slows now bite air drag and Silver's Bola grounds/interrupts her Flight, with no item change helping a poke/siege carry in a tempo meta.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The on-hit spirit carry archetype is dead, not nerfed — Mercurial Magnum, Spiritual Overflow, and the Plated Armor fix kill Wraith, Warden and Vyper's primary build in one patch.
non_obvious_calls.why: Three independent changes hit the same package: base damage and scaling cuts remove the damage and the Armor fix blocks what's left.

non_obvious_calls.claim: Veil Walker and Shadow Weave swapped identities, so heroes like Bebop, Viscous and Holliday lost a bail-out even though their kits were untouched.
non_obvious_calls.why: Sprint Boots and movespeed-on-break migrated from Veil Walker to a buffed Shadow Weave, deleting the auto-buy disengage for a 77%-buy Bebop core.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The 'global slows -20%' line reads as a mobility buff but is really an anti-flyer nerf.
non_obvious_calls.why: The new 35% air-drag clause means any slow now drags airborne heroes, so Celeste, Vindicta, Grey Talon and Lash lose positioning safety while ground kiting improves.

non_obvious_calls.claim: The Plated Armor fix is a general-sounding change that targets a specific archetype: it blanks on-hit spirit damage from Full Auto, Flight, Mercurial and Tesla.
non_obvious_calls.why: Framed as an on-hit-prevention fix, it lands as a hard counter-item exactly when the on-hit carries were already being cut.

uncertainties: The win/pick snapshot is 14 days and mostly pre-patch, so the S-tier reads (Silver, Paige, Apollo, Lash) are baseline, not confirmed post-patch outcomes.
Whether the global slow reduction genuinely eases grounded escapes or the new air-drag clause dominates the net mobility picture is unclear.
Whether removing comeback souls buries farm-first scalers (Seven, Pocket, Mirage) or they simply re-route to kill-based tempo lines within a week.
Whether Plated Armor's fix meaningfully reduces Vyper/Wraith WR or buyers just pivot to pure-gun builds that dodge it.
what_to_watch: Warden, Vyper and Wraith pick-and-win rates — if the on-hit archetype is dead, expect a sharp dip and rapid build migration.
Shadow Weave adoption on gun carries vs Veil Walker buy-rate collapse on Bebop/Holliday/Viscous.
Flyer WRs (Celeste, Vindicta, Grey Talon, Lash) as evidence the air-drag change bites.
Silver's WR against CC-heavy comps (Mo & Krill, Bebop) to see if her rise is capped.
Early Unstable Rift contest rates now that resist scales from ~10% instead of a flat 35%.
